description: OCO platform overview derived from the RR Run Substrate visual language. No runId/project selector is required: panels aggregate platform telemetry, show per-namespace telemetry coverage, recent RR runs, subsystem health, and host/runtime vitals.

panels.title: LLM requests
panels.description: All gateway upstream attempts in the selected range, including transport failures.

panels.title: LLM replies
panels.description: Successful 2xx upstream replies in the selected range.

panels.title: LLM errors
panels.description: HTTP 4xx/5xx plus transport failures.

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Local inference prompt tokens observed by vLLM and llama.cpp counters.

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: Local inference generated tokens observed by vLLM and llama.cpp counters.

panels.title: Gateway req/s
panels.description: Current aggregate gateway upstream request rate.

panels.title: Gateway p95
panels.description: Gateway end-to-end upstream request p95.

panels.title: GPU util max
panels.description: Highest currently observed GPU utilization.

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: Host CPU utilization from node_exporter.

panels.title: Host RAM
panels.description: Host memory utilization from node_exporter.

panels.title: Host disk
panels.description: Highest filesystem utilization across non-ephemeral filesystems.

panels.title: Host IOPS
panels.description: Aggregate completed read/write operations per second.

panels.title: Gateway requests by model
panels.description: Aggregate gateway request rate split by model.

panels.title: Inference token rate
panels.description: Local inference prompt/generation token rate by tier.

panels.title: Namespace telemetry
panels.description: Per-namespace telemetry visibility over the selected range. Metrics = distinct metric families currently present; Logs/Events = VictoriaLogs rows; Traces = Tempo span count via TraceQL metrics. Empty source columns remain N/A rather than zero.

targets.expr: namespace:* | stats by (namespace) count() as Logs
namespace:* AND service:="kubernetes-events" | stats by (namespace) count() as Events

panels.title: RR runs · newest first
panels.description: Recent RR runs from VictoriaLogs. This table is not a dashboard selector and does not constrain any other panel.

targets.expr: options(ignore_global_time_filter=true) {namespace="rr"} AND runId:* | stats by (runId) field_max(_time,_time) as last, field_min(_time,_time) as first, field_max(_time,project) as project, field_max(_time,status) as status, field_max(_time,event_type) as event_type | sort by (last desc) | limit 25 | pack_json fields (first,last,project,runId,status,event_type) as _msg | fields last,_msg

panels.title: MS retrieve/s
panels.description: Memory Steward selected retrievals per second.

panels.title: MS yield %
panels.description: Selected retrieval candidates / candidates considered.

panels.title: MS p95
panels.description: Memory Steward router request p95.

panels.title: MS MCP/s
panels.description: Memory Steward MCP calls per second.

panels.title: Active runs
panels.description: Current active RR runs.

panels.title: LLM runtime health
panels.description: Observed runtime target/probe health. Missing series remain N/A.

panels.title: OCO backend health
panels.description: OCO observability backend targets.

panels.title: Top network interfaces
panels.description: Top host network interfaces by combined RX+TX rate.

panels.title: Top process CPU
panels.description: Top process-exporter groups by CPU cores consumed.

panels.title: Top process RSS
panels.description: Top process-exporter groups by resident memory.

panels.title: Disk devices · IOPS
panels.description: Top block devices by completed operations per second.

panels.title: Disk devices · throughput
panels.description: Top block devices by read+write byte throughput.

panels.title: Filesystems · usage
panels.description: Most utilized non-ephemeral host filesystems.

panels.title: Platform warnings / failures
panels.description: Newest warning/error/failure telemetry across collected namespaces. This is intentionally platform-wide, not tied to an RR run.

targets.expr: (status:="failed" OR status:="error" OR detected_level:="warning" OR detected_level:="warn" OR detected_level:="error" OR detected_level:="fatal") | sort by (_time desc) | limit 30 | fields _time,namespace,service,pod,detected_level,status,_msg

title: OCO / Platform Overview
